verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a desktop remote-access client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. 'Privacy mode' and peer-to-peer connections are adjacent features, not telemetry controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
